title: BOLD signal changes can oppose oxygen metabolism across the human cortex
goal: Reproduce the original Figure5 fitted-estimation result: baseline CMRO2 from OEF, CBF and CBV, and task-related deltaCMRO2 from deltaOEF and deltaCBF, separately in the source concordant and discordant voxel strata. Preserve all four models, original participant/voxel support, physiological-map and mask lineage, centering and source fit outputs. Retain the paper's other physiological findings as separately named evidence; fitted agreement does not establish independent physiological accuracy. Assess improvement only if a meaningful same-result criterion beyond fitting the Fick-derived target can be justified.

success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v2.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.

Use outcomes.v1.json for the matched information conditions and budgets; a declared contract or admitted receipt is not scientific qualification.
